name: orgchart-node
description: An absolutely-positioned content box representing an entity in an ownership/hierarchy diagram. Renders at fixed pixel dimensions on a 1056x816px canvas (US Letter landscape). Three shape families: rectangle (operating entities), pill (fund vehicles), ellipse (cross-border flow-throughs).

variants.name: rectangle
variants.description: Standard operating/holding entity — solid border, one of 5 role colors (green/blue/purple/orange/grey).

variants.name: pill
variants.description: Fund vehicle / limited partnership — always dashed border, 250px wide, fully rounded.

variants.name: ellipse
variants.description: Cross-border flow-through entity — dashed or dotted border, rounded.

aria: role='group' + aria-label='{{entity-name}} node {{node-number}}' on each box div. The SVG connector layer (see orgchart-connector) uses pointer-events:none and requires no ARIA annotation.
motion: Print-first, static component -- no interaction states.
open_questions: oq-1: Should the short-radius and rounded administrative-entity variants be consolidated into one modifier, or kept distinct for different subcategories?
